articles.title: Dev Machine Guard Now Inventories Where Developer Credentials Live
articles.description: Dev Machine Guard now inventories where developer tools keep credentials. See which credential sources are in use across your fleet, how many devices each one affects, and how much of that material is sitting in plaintext. Credential values, fragments, hashes, and fingerprints are never stored, displayed, or sent off the device.

articles.title: Dev Machine Guard Now Inventories Browser Extensions on Developer Machines
articles.description: Dev Machine Guard now inventories browser extensions across your developer fleet. See every extension installed in Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, what each one is currently permitted to do, whether it came from a marketplace or was installed some other way, and which devices are running it.

articles.title: The State of Open Source Supply Chain Attacks
articles.description: StepSecurity threat intelligence tracked 56 open source supply chain attacks from August 2025 to August 2026, roughly one every three days since March. See the data and the defenses.

articles.title: Rust Supply-Chain Attack: arrayref, internment, and append-only-vec Poisoned by the proc-macro1 Build-Time Dropper
articles.description: Three Rust crates are compromised: arrayref 0.3.10, internment 0.8.7, and append-only-vec 0.1.9 each added a typosquatted build-time dependency (proc-macro1, proc-macro-en) whose build script downloads and runs a remote binary during cargo build. Full technical analysis: timeline, dropper dissection, runtime detection, IOCs, and remediation.
